description: This file implements a system notification manager for news updates in an Android app, including creating notifications, handling notification channels, and generating deep links for news resources.

classes.name: SystemTrayNotifier
classes.description: A singleton class that manages posting news notifications in the system tray, including creating individual notifications and a summary notification.

methods.name: postNewsNotifications
methods.description: Posts a list of news resource notifications, including individual notifications and a summary notification.

methods.name: newsNotificationStyle
methods.description: Creates an inbox style summary for news notifications.

methods.name: createNewsNotification
methods.description: Builds a notification with specified properties.

methods.name: ensureNotificationChannelExists
methods.description: Creates a notification channel if not already present (Android O and above).

methods.name: newsPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent for a news resource deep link.

methods.name: newsDeepLinkUri
methods.description: Generates a deep link URI for a news resource.
